title: Announced intersyndicale 48-hour school stoppage
reason: Available evidence describes a planned class stoppage and subsequent school absence, not a qualifying public assembly; no 50-person protest attendance is established.
notes: Search results say the stoppage was announced for 17–18 January and report that schools in Mohéli remained empty on 18 January after the intersyndicale reportedly suspended the action. The Africa-Press items remain under the inherited publisher hold, so execution details are search-only. Teacher absence, school closures and affected students are not crowd attendance. Exclusion means insufficient evidence for a codeable public event, not a claim that no strike occurred.
